title: Fig Tidies Up
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, consonants x, y, z added, 29-sound stage.

pages.brief: Fig the green caterpillar standing on a mossy log beside a compost heap.
A scattered mess of plain clay pots and tin cups tipped over on and around the log, Fig looking at it.
Several plain clay pots and tin cups lying across the top of the log in a jumble.
Fig the caterpillar nudging a clay pot upright with his head, a tin cup beside him.
Fig the caterpillar pushing a small clay pot into the top of an open cloth bag.
Fig the caterpillar pushing a tin cup into the same open cloth bag.
The log now bare and clear, the full cloth bag sitting beside it on the ground.
Fig the caterpillar sitting happily on the now-tidy log, the compost heap neat behind him.
